package registration

import (
	"github.com/viant/datly/runtime/handler"
	fixture "github.com/viant/datly/transcribe/testdata/handleronly"
	"github.com/viant/xdatly"
)

// Reference is handwritten registration using the same native output contract.
type Reference struct {
	Contract xdatly.Component[fixture.Input, fixture.CaseOutput] `component:"Reference,path=/reference,method=POST,handler=github.com/viant/datly/transcribe/testdata/handleronly.NewCaseHandler" caseFormat:"lc" mcp:"[{\"kind\":\"tool\",\"name\":\"Reference\"}]"`
}

func (Reference) DatlyHandler(name string) func() (handler.TypedHandler, error) {
	return ConvertDatly.DatlyHandler(name)
}
